compiler.name: hand_mapped_transposed_fir32_modulo_schedule
compiler.kernel_form: 32-tap transposed FIR with predicate-gated input and predicate-controlled output store
compiler.cross_tile_value: x_eff forward on 16-tile snake; transposed state values backward; y/p down left column
limitations: predicate pattern is compile-time constant for this directed verification kernel
control words are semantic, not bit-packed chunks
requires target encoder to turn semantic controls into RTL control-word chunks

modulo_schedule.main_token_arrival: x_eff[n] arrives logical tile i at I(n)+i

t00_phases.action: MUL h1*x_eff; capture z1_next from T01; prefetch x[n+1]
load compile-time predicate p[n+1] into P0

generic_tile_i_1_to_14.action: MUL h[2i]*x_in; save x; route x/p forward
ADD h[2i]*x + z[2i]; route result backward as z[2i-1]_next
ADD h[2i+1]*x + z[2i+1]_old -> z[2i]_new; capture next-tile result into ping/pong z[2i+1]

tile15.action: ADD h30*x+z30; route backward as z29_next
